concerns.text: The Data Model defines a field `local_non_additivity_index` per molecule (Output Data table), but the Implementation Plan (Task T015) only computes LNAI per fingerprint bit‑pair and outputs `data/derived/lna_index.csv`. No per‑molecule LNAI artifact is produced, violating the data‑model specification.
The `prediction.schema.yaml` contract is never exercised by any task in the plan; there is no plan element that generates records conforming to this schema.
The `molecule.schema.yaml` contract is not referenced by any task in the plan, leaving the contract unvalidated.
